rules.publicationTitle: State Disability Insurance (SDI) Rates and Withholding
exclusions: Not applied in bonus or self-employment mode.
rules.applicabilityNotes: State Disability Insurance employee contribution; bonus mode excludes SDI.

rules.publicationTitle: Colorado FAMLI Premium and Benefits Calculator (2026 premium rates)
exclusions: Not applied in bonus or self-employment mode.
Employers may choose to pay the full premium, in which case nothing is withheld.
rules.applicabilityNotes: Employee share of the FAMLI premium: half of the 0.88% total, i.e. 0.44% of wages up to the $184,500 federal Social Security wage cap.

rules.publicationTitle: Connecticut Paid Leave Contributions
exclusions: Not applied in bonus or self-employment mode.
Connecticut caps contributions at the Social Security contribution base; that cap is not applied here, so a high earner's premium is overstated late in the year.
rules.applicabilityNotes: Employee Paid Family and Medical Leave contribution of 0.5% of wages.

rules.publicationTitle: RCW 50B.04.080 — WA Cares Premium Assessment
exclusions: Not applied in bonus or self-employment mode.
rules.applicabilityNotes: WA Cares Fund employee premium, subject to exemption input.

rules.publicationTitle: New Jersey Department of Labor — Employer Rate Information (2026 worker rates and taxable wage bases)
exclusions: Not applied in bonus or self-employment mode.
Worker Unemployment Insurance and Workforce Development contributions on the separate $44,800 base are not withheld here.
rules.applicabilityNotes: Temporary Disability Insurance (0.19%) and Family Leave Insurance (0.23%) worker contributions on the $171,100 worker taxable wage base.

rules.publicationTitle: New York Paid Family Leave 2026 contribution rate; Workers' Compensation Law 209(3)(a) disability contribution
exclusions: Not applied in bonus or self-employment mode.
Employers may elect to pay either contribution on the employee's behalf, in which case nothing is withheld.
rules.applicabilityNotes: Paid Family Leave employee contribution of 0.432% capped at $411.91 per year, plus the statutory disability contribution of 0.5% of wages capped at $0.60 per week.

rules.publicationTitle: Massachusetts Department of Family and Medical Leave — Contribution Rates and Calculator (2026)
exclusions: Not applied in bonus or self-employment mode.
Employers may choose to cover more than the minimum employee share, reducing or eliminating the withholding.
rules.applicabilityNotes: Employee share of the Paid Family and Medical Leave contribution: 0.28% medical and 0.18% family, capped by the Social Security taxable maximum.

rules.publicationTitle: Rhode Island Department of Labor and Training — TDI/TCI for Employers (2026)
exclusions: Not applied in bonus or self-employment mode.
rules.applicabilityNotes: Temporary Disability Insurance employee wage deduction of 1.1% on a $100,000 taxable wage base.

rules.publicationTitle: Paid Leave Oregon — Employer contribution rates (2026)
exclusions: Not applied in bonus or self-employment mode.
Employers may choose to pay all or part of the employee contribution, reducing or eliminating the withholding.
rules.applicabilityNotes: Employee share of Paid Leave Oregon: 60% of the 1% total contribution, i.e. 0.6% of gross wages up to $184,500.

rules.publicationTitle: Hawaii DLIR Disability Compensation Division — 2026 Maximum Weekly Wage Base and Maximum Weekly Benefit Amount
exclusions: Not applied in bonus or self-employment mode.
rules.applicabilityNotes: Temporary Disability Insurance employee share, capped at 0.5% of weekly wages and a $7.50 maximum weekly deduction; suppressed when the employer carries the full premium.

rules.publicationTitle: 2026 Maryland State and Local Income Tax Withholding Information, Attachment 1 — Local Income Tax Withholding Rates for 2026
exclusions: Not applied in bonus or self-employment mode.
rules.applicabilityNotes: County income tax on Maryland taxable wages, set by the county of residence reported on Form MW507. Anne Arundel and Frederick apply graduated marginal rates. Employees who report no county are withheld at the highest local rate, 3.30%, as the Comptroller directs.
